# Ahmad Faruqui

Ahmad Faruqui is a well-known economist and energy consultant who has built a reputation in several areas:

## Professional Background

- **Energy Economics & Utility Consulting**: He is perhaps best known for his work in electricity pricing, demand response, and smart grid economics. He has been a principal or managing director at **The Brattle Group**, a prominent economic consulting firm, and previously worked at **EPRI (Electric Power Research Institute)** and other organizations.

- **Expertise in Dynamic Pricing**: Faruqui is widely regarded as one of the foremost experts on electricity rate design, particularly time-of-use pricing, critical peak pricing, and real-time pricing. He has studied how consumers respond to price signals and has been influential in promoting smart metering and dynamic pricing structures globally.

- He has consulted for utilities, regulators, and governments across numerous countries on multiple continents.

## Academic & Intellectual Work

- He holds a **PhD in economics** (from the University of California, Davis, if I recall correctly).
- He has published extensively in academic journals, trade publications, and has authored or co-authored several books.
- He has written on **defense economics and military strategy**, particularly relating to **Pakistan's military and security issues**.
- He authored **"Rethinking the National Security of Pakistan"** and has written about South Asian geopolitics.

## Writing & Commentary

- He has contributed opinion pieces and articles to various newspapers and publications, including those focused on South Asian affairs.
- He is known for bridging quantitative economic analysis with broader policy and strategic thinking.

## Personal Background

- He is of **Pakistani descent** and has maintained an active interest in Pakistani and South Asian affairs alongside his energy economics work.

## Notable Contributions

- His empirical work compiling and analyzing results from **hundreds of dynamic pricing pilots** worldwide has been particularly influential in regulatory proceedings and utility planning.
- He has been a frequent speaker at industry conferences and regulatory forums.

---

**Caveat**: Some details here are drawn from my training data, which has a knowledge cutoff, and I may have minor inaccuracies. I'd recommend checking his current professional profiles for the most up-to-date information.
